component.name: Powerwall TV
component.summary: View your Tesla Powerwall status on Linux

description.p: Powerwall TV brings your Tesla Powerwall data to the big screen on Linux. It supports both local network access and Tesla Fleet API access, so you can monitor your energy system at home or away.

In Local mode, enter your Powerwall gateway IP address and credentials to see near real-time power flow and status updates. In Fleet API mode, sign in with Tesla to securely access your energy site through Tesla cloud APIs.
The dashboard includes live power flow visuals and dedicated graphs for solar, battery, home, and grid metrics, with battery percentage trends for quick at-a-glance monitoring.
